name: Limoux

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation around Limoux, covering sparkling and still wines. Mauzac, Chardonnay and Chenin Blanc are used for whites, and reds are blended from Merlot, Malbec, Syrah, Grenache, Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon. Limoux claims the world's first sparkling wine, made by monks at Saint-Hilaire and recorded in 1531.
